Self.Wiki: A character placed in the map: MT and AC opponents, drones, turrets, bosses and the invisible c9980 helper characters events use. At map load the game builds each character from its NPC, Think and CharaInit rows and the fields below, joins it to the PlatoonInfo event that lists it, and starts its walk route. Retail: 3225 Enemies in 88 maps.

Enemy_ActionButtonParamID.Wiki: An ActionButtonParam row for an interaction prompt on this character. -1 for none. Retail: set on 100 enemies, 0 on 6.

NPCParamID.Wiki: The NpcParam row that sets the character's stats and behaviour. Its defaultLodParamId, when 0 or more, replaces the map object's own LOD setting. The game can swap in another row at run time (an override kept on the map object).

ThinkParamID.Wiki: The NpcThinkParam row that sets the character's AI script and senses. The game can swap in another row at run time (an override kept on the map object). Retail: 0 on 62 enemies and 1 on 70 (mostly c9980 helpers).

TalkID.Wiki: The talk script (ESD) the character runs. 0 for none. Retail: set on 164 enemies, 510 on 96 of them.

Enemy_Unk16.Wiki: No effect found: the game has a getter for it but nothing calls it. It sits where Elden Ring keeps the Platoon ID; Armored Core VI finds a character's platoon from the PlatoonInfo event that lists it instead. Retail: 10-600 on 27 enemies, 0 on the rest.

CharaInitID.Wiki: The CharaInitParam row that sets an AC's parts and loadout. Only used when greater than 0. Retail: set on 63 enemies, all AC characters (c0xxx).

CollisionPartName.Wiki: A collision whose display groups the character takes at map load, so it is drawn with that area. Leave empty to keep its own display groups. Retail: empty on every Enemy.

WalkRouteName.Wiki: The Patrol Route event the character walks. Its Patrol regions give the points, Action IDs and Turn Types. Retail: set on 337 enemies.

Enemy_Unk22.Wiki: Characters with the same group ID share targets (the game's own debug label for it is 'Target Sharing Group ID'; how far the sharing goes was not traced). The game builds one group for each value of 0 or more; two characters count as grouped only when both values are above 0 and equal. -1 for none. Retail: set on 690 enemies, most groups 3 or more (values such as 1, 10, 100, 200, 300, 600).

BackupEventAnimID.Wiki: The animation the character idles with when nothing else plays. -1 for the default. Retail: set on 636 enemies, mostly 1110-1118.

Enemy_LinkedEntityID.Wiki: The Entity ID of another character or asset this one belongs to, such as the carrier a turret or drone is mounted on. A short ID (below 10000) is expanded to the map's full entity ID at load, like every entity ID. 0 for none. No reader of the value was found, so its effect is not confirmed. Retail: set on 449 enemies. In m01_01_30_00 every c7401 / c7402 names one of the map's c7400; c3020 drones name a c5100; c9980 helpers name bosses, assets, or full IDs in other maps.

Enemy_Unk44.Wiki: No reader found. Set mostly on characters with a Parent Entity ID, with small values that look like dummy poly IDs on the parent's model (c7401: 10-13; c7402: 20-25, 38-42; c3020: 60-63). -1 for none. Retail: set on 465 enemies.

Enemy_Unk48.Wiki: Copied into the character's setup when it is created; what reads it there was not traced. Retail: 0, or 60 on 8 c3020 enemies in m01_04_80_00 (Xylem), each with 0x44 also 60.

Enemy_Unk55.Wiki: Overrides one setup step of the character. 0: the step runs unless a flag on the character's component blocks it. 1: never runs. 2: always runs. The component can also force it. What the step does was not traced. Retail: 2 on one enemy (c0000_0002 in m01_03_70_00), 0 on the rest.

KillPayoutClassification.Wiki: The payout class this character counts as when killed in a mission that pays per kill. -1 for none. Retail: -1 on 2330 enemies, otherwise 0-7.

PartsTokenParamID.Wiki: The PartsTokenParam row the character drops. -1 for none. Retail: set on 86 enemies, 0 on 17.

UnkEnemyStruct70.Wiki: Up to five directions the character looks around in while idle. In the common non-battle AI (aicommon goal_act_func), a character within 10 m of its start point turns to the current angle (measured from its start facing, in degrees), waits 5-7 seconds, then moves on to the next, wrapping round after the last (Lua GetInitialPointTurnAngle / NextInitialPointTurnAngle). Further than 10 m away, it walks back first. Slots set to -1 are skipped. Retail: set on 62 enemies, for example 0, 90 or 300, 60.

UnkEnemyStruct78.Wiki: No effect: fixed values the game does not read. Holds no editable values.

UnkStruct98.Wiki: No effect for a character. Holds no editable values.

UnkE3C.Wiki: No effect for a character: only asset code reads it. Retail: -1 on every Enemy.

UnkE3E.Wiki: No effect found: the game has a getter for it but nothing calls it. Retail: 0 on every Enemy.
